category: other: spatula slipped out of the grasp while the blade was pushed into the pot
what_happened: Scene: layout 8 (same kitchen as s8, s10), light pot (Pot075) on the rear-left grate, lime, carrot and spatula_6 (teal handle, yellow blade) on the counter LEFT of the range. Stage 0: lime grasped 158, dropped in 239 (complete 241). Stage 1: carrot grasped 306, dropped in 404 (complete 404, fast). Stage 2 was slow: the arm stretched far left and from ~560 to ~900 (~340 steps) hovered with open fingers over the handle, which lay diagonally across the finger gap (wrist view almost unchanged 600-900); it closed at 906 and lifted (complete 929; 525 steps vs median 152, p90 217). Stage 3: the spatula reached the pot at ~1000; 1120-1420 the blade was inside the pot, worked around the right half and the middle (1280-1320 deep in the pot). Only 1 stir step was counted (success_time 1). At ~1428 the spatula slipped out of the fingers (width 0.017 -> 0.002 at 1440; stage 2 ends 1428) and fell into the pot, handle sticking out. The gripper stayed closed and the arm drifted toward the microwave until 1600.
causal_chain: ~340-step hover before closing on the spatula (560-906) -> stirring in the pot 1120-1420 but only 1 of 5 stir steps counted -> spatula slipped out ~1428 (stage 2 undone) -> closed gripper, no re-grasp -> timeout with success_time 1
self_recovery: The pre-grasp stall resolved itself at 906. After the slip, no re-grasp.
official_criterion_notes: Near miss on the stir counter (1 of 5). Video shows ~300 steps with the blade in the pot among the vegetables; the criterion needs veg1 (lime) touched by the spatula and both vegetables moving > 0.5 mm in the same step, which the slow, mostly pressing motion rarely produced. Packet first_incomplete_stage is 2 only because PickUpSpatula is evaluated as 'held and lifted now' (not latched); the online log completed stages 0-2, so the failed stage is 3.

packet_facts: spatula close 906 width 0.029 lifted; stage2 929-1428 (steps_since_previous 525, typical 152)

uncertain_about: Whether the blade ever touched the lime (veg1) during the stir; what made the handle slip at 1428 (the hand is over the pot and occludes the blade).
